page: Google Cloud Platform tpu7x-standard-4t is an accelerator-optimized server configured with 224 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 960.0 GB of system memory. The primary compute capability is driven by four integrated Google TPU v7x accelerators, providing a total of 768 GB of high-bandwidth Tensor Processing Unit VRAM. This hardware configuration is designed for massive parallel processing workloads, specifically machine learning training and large-scale AI inference.

The host system allocates 4.29 GB of memory per core across its 224 dedicated vCPUs. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, meaning storage requirements must be met through external network-attached storage options. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the integration of four Google TPU v7x accelerators, this server is highly cost-efficient for deep learning workloads compared to general-purpose CPU instances, offering high resource density for tensor operations. It is optimized for workloads such as large language model training, generative AI, complex neural network optimization, and high-throughput data science pipelines.
